description: This source file defines a static utility class `StreamHelper` for reading and writing big-endian integers to and from streams, as well as reading header bytes, within the PDFsharp library's internal PNG processing code.

classes.name: StreamHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to read/write big-endian 32-bit integers and to read PNG header bytes from streams.

methods.name: ReadBigEndianInt32
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte big-endian integer from a stream.

methods.name: ReadBigEndianInt32
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte big-endian integer from a byte array starting at a given offset.

methods.name: WriteBigEndianInt32
methods.description: Writes a 4-byte big-endian integer to a stream.

methods.name: ReadOrTerminate
methods.description: Reads a byte from a stream, throwing an exception if the stream ends unexpectedly.

methods.name: TryReadHeaderBytes
methods.description: Attempts to read 8 header bytes from a stream.
